concepts.proposed_markdown: - Direct `applicable_product_ids` and `applicable_product_tags` use any-match semantics across the listed selectors. For richer targeting, fields within one `specifiers` object are ANDed, while separate objects in the array are ORed; these objects can test pricing-group values, presentation-group values, or product tags.

- A pricing- or presentation-group specifier matches only products carrying the corresponding group key and value. Subscription and composite products never carry pricing or presentation group values, so they cannot draw down a credit or commit targeted solely through those group-value conditions.
